label: ACCEPT
reason: Members (add-edit-integration.ts, archive-partner.ts, send-test-webhook.ts) are wrapped in the session/workspace-checking clients from safe-action.ts, and no lint or type rule requires it. Every outlier is an exported async function in a "use server" file, so a reachable server action that skips the auth client: pre-auth flows on bare actionClient + throwIfAuthenticated (send-otp, sign-up, password reset) are exceptions worth confirming (R3), while server-only helpers like banPartner/forceWithdrawal/markSubmittedLeadClosedWon and the AI actions take caller-supplied workspace/partner objects or call the LLM with no session check.
